d1.text: Wait. I never told her my name.

d2.text: How do you know my name?

m2.text: Everyone here knows you. Apartment thirteen-oh-four. The guy who never pays rent.

m3.text: The main stairs are blocked. Take the service stairs. You'll need a maintenance keycard.

d4.text: B. Patel. Maintenance. That's my landlord's card.

d5.text: And a note. Don't open. They were my tenants.

d6.text: He locked them in... before he turned.

m4.text: Dev. One more thing. Don't trust anyone else up there.

d7.text: The mirror said the same thing. About her.

d8.text: Someone else is up here. And they're alive.

end.text: Part five. Follow, and find out who's behind that door.
